title: Authorization and tenant-isolation adversarial matrix

eligibility.live_issue_note: body still says waiting_plan_integration; PR43 integration is complete, but dependencies/runtime acceptance remain

cases.attack_or_failure: request a route whose authoritative server route/data capability is absent; UI hiding is only incidental
cases.expected_result: deny server-side with a uniform safe response and no protected record/count leak
cases.evidence_to_pass: route/data capability denial plus separate proof that presentation visibility alone neither grants nor revokes server capability

cases.expected_result: ignore/reject client authority and return zero foreign data
deny with a uniform safe response; record and evaluate latency residual rather than claim perfect timing indistinguishability
cases.evidence_to_pass: same-company isolation policy, response-shape equivalence and measured timing distribution/residual

cases.attack_or_failure: view permission exists but export capability is absent

cases.expected_result: reject field operation and omit unauthorized aggregates

cases.attack_or_failure: continue using stale page/cache/hub after revocation
old tab sends query/command after another tab logs out
cases.expected_result: deny old generation and clear/mask protected cache

cases.attack_or_failure: Back reveals prior user content after account switch
cases.expected_result: mask then revalidate; never transfer draft/cache authority

cases.attack_or_failure: craft protected ScreenId into personal shortcut

cases.evidence_to_pass: schema fuzz and no SQL-object-input proof

cases.attack_or_failure: open reference owned by another scope
keep SignalR/polling active without accepted interaction
cases.expected_result: expire session; background traffic does not extend idle

cases.attack_or_failure: late result from previous company arrives
cases.expected_result: discard by context generation and requery

cases.attack_or_failure: external origin or missing/invalid CSRF token submits a protected state-changing request
cases.expected_result: reject before handler dispatch, session-activity/context mutation, or business effect; same-origin valid-token control remains allowed
cases.evidence_to_pass: CSRF middleware integration tests covering command, company switch and Continue Session

cases.attack_or_failure: stale SSR or hydration cache briefly renders protected data after permission/session generation changes
cases.expected_result: server authority check prevents protected bytes from entering the response or hydration payload
cases.evidence_to_pass: synthetic stale-generation SSR/hydration test proving zero protected-field and protected-count disclosure

cases.attack_or_failure: reuse a job, artifact, or download token after tenant/company/storehouse scope changes
cases.expected_result: deny under the current authoritative scope and never reuse an artifact across scope generations
cases.evidence_to_pass: immutable server-resolved artifact scope plus current-generation authorization at status and download

cases.attack_or_failure: infer record existence from response timing, size, pagination count, or distinct denial code
cases.expected_result: return a uniform safe denial envelope within a documented synthetic variance budget and reveal no protected count
cases.evidence_to_pass: paired present/absent forbidden-record trials with normalized response shape and timing-distribution review

cases.attack_or_failure: enqueue while authorized, then revoke permission or change tenant/company/session generation before worker dispatch
cases.expected_result: reauthorize before dispatch against immutable server-resolved scope and reject the stale envelope
cases.evidence_to_pass: synthetic queued-action generation-race test proving no business mutation after revocation
